property_summary: For any recipient and amount, if the reference sendMoney call with sufficient gas succeeds, the buggy version reverts when the recipient uses more than 2300 gas; the test deploys a gas-consuming callee and asserts that the reference succeeds while the mutant reverts on the same call.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call with a regular transfer, which forwards a fixed 2300 gas and reverts on failure, changing the observable success/failure behavior for recipients with fallback logic requiring more gas or returning data.
